sidebar.title: Elasticsearch connections
sidebar.deleteDescription: The connection and every grant under it are removed from all backends. This does not touch the Elasticsearch cluster itself. This cannot be undone.

dialog.description: Credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Use Share on the sidebar to grant read / write access without revealing the secret.
dialog.cloudIdHelp: Elastic Cloud id. Decodes to a node URL server-side — an alternative to Node URLs above.
dialog.kibanaNote: Runs ES requests through Kibana's Dev Tools proxy using your Kibana access — no ES cluster credentials needed.
dialog.apiKeyHelp: Sent as <0>{{header}}</0>. Paste the encoded id:api_key.
dialog.kibanaUrlHelp: Base URL of Kibana. ES queries are proxied through its Dev Tools Console.
dialog.cookieHelp: Paste the full session cookie as <0>name=value</0>, not just the value. Kibana usually calls it sid; OpenSearch Dashboards uses security_authentication (paste all security_authentication* cookies, separated by ;). Find them in DevTools → Application → Cookies.
dialog.cookieSetNote: A cookie is set — leave blank to keep it.
dialog.spaceHelp: Kibana space slug — leave empty for the default space.
dialog.tlsHelp: Connect over https:// (also implied by an https node scheme).
dialog.backendLocalDesc: Talks to the cluster from your local machine. Required for 127.0.0.1 / LAN nodes.
dialog.backendRemoteDesc: Talks to the cluster from the team backend. Use for prod / staging behind VPN.
dialog.backendNote: The connection is saved to BOTH backends — credentials get encrypted with each BE's own key. Pick which one this connection defaults to.
dialog.caCertHelp: Custom CA used to verify the cluster's TLS certificate.
dialog.caFingerprintHelp: ES8 self-signed CA pinning — the server cert SHA-256 must match.
dialog.skipTlsHelp: Accept any cluster certificate. Insecure — dev / self-signed only.
dialog.clientKeyHelp: Client cert + key enable mTLS (mutual TLS).
dialog.errNodeRequired: At least one node URL or a Cloud ID is required

share.title: Share "{{name}}"
share.description: Recipients act through this connection without seeing the stored credentials. Read = search / browse / _cat; write = index, update, delete & _bulk.

console.noConnections: No connections yet. Add one from the Elasticsearch sidebar tab.
console.writesTooltipOn: Off by default. Enable to let mutating requests (PUT / DELETE / _bulk / _update_by_query…) through — the backend still re-checks your write grant.
console.writesTooltipReadonly: You have read-only access to this connection. Writes are unavailable.
console.cheatsheetTip: Grouped Kibana-console recipes. Click one to insert it.
console.indicesTip: Browse indices, open mapping / settings / stats, warm field autocomplete.
console.copyCurlTip: Copy the request under the cursor as a curl command (secrets shown as placeholders).
console.importCurlTip: Paste a curl command to append it as a console request.
console.beautifyTip: Pretty-print the JSON body of every request in the buffer.
console.validateTip: Check the query under the cursor with _validate/query?explain — errors surface as inline markers.
console.runAllTip: Run every request in the buffer top to bottom.
console.runTip: Run the request under the cursor against {{target}}.
console.emptyWithConn: Put the cursor in a request and press ⌘↵ (or Run). Requests are separated by a blank line.
console.emptyNoConn: Pick a connection above to get started.
console.savedTip: Save queries for this connection and reopen them later (⌘S). Kept on this device.

result.flattenTitle: Flatten nested _source objects into dotted columns
result.noHits: No hits in this response. Try the Raw view{{aggs}}.

saved.title: Saved queries
saved.empty: No saved queries for this connection yet.
